leadText:
Stonesthrow Town (Japanese: チカクノタウン Chikakuno Town) is an -exclusive location in the Unova region that appeared in Clash of the Connoisseurs!. It is a village located between Icirrus City and Opelucid City. Just outside the town is an enormous mansion owned by Mr. Hatterly who lives there with his daughter.
 
 , and were staying in the Pokémon Center here when Nurse Joy told Ash that the Opelucid Gym was closed. Shortly after, they were confronted by a butler who told them to come with him. The butler took them to the mansion of Mr. Hatterly, who wanted Cilan's help to pick a Pokémon for his beloved daughter.
